catalog_ddl_limit: An already-executed but uncommitted optional CREATE does not retain catalog RowExclusiveLock. It can commit while repair holds catalog SHARE locks. Live catalog name resolution makes the in-transaction assertion detect it and roll back both metadata writes. This case is additional evidence for independent review, not a claim that catalog locks exclude every already-executed DDL commit.
